## 4.0-S8 (final dossier slice)

**xsl:array / xsl:array-member (§21.1.2):** `BuildArrayFromInstruction` — no @for-each: @select/content items become singleton members; with @for-each: one member per focus item (whole per-item sequence); nested `xsl:array-member` contributes exactly one sequence-valued member (spec grouping shape pinned by test); select+content → XTSE3185; emission mirrors xsl:map (SENR0001/XTDE0450). Standalone array-member + XTTE4060-JNode notes recorded as deviations.

**xsl:switch (§8.3):** @select coerced to one atomic (XPTY0004 otherwise); @test atomic items compared under general-comparison `=` with NaN guard, instruction-scoped collation; first match wins, lazy (error()-pinned); no match → `()`. `xsl:when`/`xsl:otherwise` gain @select ONLY under xsl:switch — xsl:choose bit-identical.

**Pattern system (§6.3–6.4) — analysis per contract:** union-pattern priority needs NO change (Bosak always used max-of-branches = the 4.0 rule); new map/array/record pattern forms analyzed as feasible+additive but their own slice; the §6.4.2 type-pattern priority table changes would flip frozen-catalog outcomes (match-167/171) — recorded as known deviation needing an owner decision on a true 4.0 XSLT mode.

## Gates

- Build 0/0; unit all green (Xslt.Tests 812 = +31, solution total 3,310); QT3 **exactly 31,142/0/679**; XSLT smoke 162/0/26

Docs synced: FEATURE_REQUESTS (S8 row + analysis), INTEGRATION §0, AGENT_HANDOVER sixty-fourth session.
